FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 162
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative James Lomax
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/20/2024
House Bill 162 as introduced could decrease potential ad valorem tax receipts collected on
Class IV property to the following funds by the annual amounts listed by capping the growth in
the assessed value of such property at no more than 3% of the assessed value of the previous
year, pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
